shapeSummary: 48 mm diameter, 6 mm thick disc wheel with its axis along Y (Y=0 to 6), a 14 mm through bore, a 38 mm diameter by 3 mm deep recess on the top face leaving a 3 mm web, and eight 4 mm through holes around the bore at about a 24 mm bolt circle.
warnings: The 4 mm holes look slightly oval or slotted in the drawing, so they are modeled as round 4 mm holes.
The diagonal hole positions are estimated from the 24 mm and 16 mm dimensions.
Which face carries the recess is ambiguous, so it is placed on the top face (Y=3 to 6).
The rubber lip is not modeled separately and is treated as part of the single solid.
The disc axis is along Y to match the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, while the source analysis described it along Z.
cadquery:
part = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(24).extrude(-6)
recess = cq.Workplane('XZ').workplane(offset=-3).circle(19).extrude(-3)
part = part.cut(recess)
bore = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(7).extrude(-6)
part = part.cut(bore)
pts = [(12,0),(-12,0),(0,12),(0,-12),(8,8.7),(-8,8.7),(8,-8.7),(-8,-8.7)]
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints(pts).circle(2).extrude(-6)
part = part.cut(holes)
